card.name: Postmarketing section wording
card.fires_on: The word marketing (or the word right after it) in 'post-marketing' or 'postmarketing' before surveillance, reports, studies or experience in adverse-reaction text. It also fires weakly on a few unrelated compound terms.

modes.label: Postmarketing phrase
modes.description: Marketing or the following noun in 'post-marketing' phrases introducing adverse event reports.
